acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Djinn family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Great Djinn, T4, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Script-Storm Champion (Champion) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two fire construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Giant storm-colored smoke body, jeweled crown, and sacred script written visibly through surrounding vapor.
Signature mechanic: Crowned Clause: the jeweled crown points to one sacred line written in vapor, and the giant body curls around that line until its final glyph closes.
battlefieldDuty: Control alternating script zones through a giant storm-colored body without obscuring the readable binding glyph.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 vapor, half-face, and trailing plume gain an internal ceramic heat baffle; T2 the defined torso and plain cuffs gain an external fuel seam; T3 visible wind arms and orbiting rings gain ignition gaps; T4 crown and sacred script gain exhaust glyphs; T5 vortex, throne, and lamps gain bounded cooling tethers.

Motion/process branches use an engineered combustion process with tiered apparatus: T1 the vapor half-face draws fuel through a hidden plume baffle; T2 the torso exhausts through one cuff seam; T3 the wind arms ignite in orbiting-ring order; T4 crown script opens one exhaust glyph; T5 vortex, throne, and lamps feed and cool one tethered cycle.
counterplay: Cross outside the writing direction and break the final open glyph before the storm body closes around it. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the vapor half-face opens its plume-baffle apparatus after exhaust; T2 the torso cuff exposes its cooling fuel seam; T3 wind arms and orbiting rings expose the ignition gap after release; T4 crown script opens its exhaust glyph between clauses; T5 vortex, throne, and lamps expose the cooling tether after a combustion cycle.
forbiddenTreatments: Native warmth or smoke alone presented as Fire affinity
identityInvariants: A hovering humanoid upper body tapers into smoke instead of legs; solidity and scale change only at explicit tiers.
Sapphire or violet smoke, warm inner light, gold, brass, turquoise, silk, and gemstones remain distinct source materials.
Cuffs, rings, headpieces, lamps, and script mark proposed binding status without establishing universal culture or morality.
The body becomes less solid and more spatially dominant from half-face vapor to a palace-scale throne vortex.
telegraph: One crown jewel aligns with the floor while sacred script writes outward from the matching smoke shoulder.
